title: Rotman Summer Reads (University of Toronto) — Eric closes the 2026 series with a 45-minute virtual conversation
summary: The University of Toronto's Rotman School of Management concludes its 2026 Summer Reads series on August 18 with Eric — a 45-minute virtual noon conversation on how organizations can sustain success without losing sight of their purpose. More than 1,000 people tuned in virtually to the series this summer. Complimentary registration; livestream-plus-book tickets available.
blockquote: More than 1,000 people tuned in virtually for Rotman Summer Reads this summer. On August 18, the series concludes with bestselling author Eric Ries and a timely conversation on how organizations can sustain success without losing sight of their purpose.
